using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;
public class LayoutCheck : EditorWindow {
 static LayoutCheck window;
 static double deadline;
 static HashSet<string> importedPaths = new HashSet<string>();
 static Dictionary<string, TemplateContainer> clones = new Dictionary<string, TemplateContainer>();
 /* IMPORT_METHODS */
 public static void Run() {
  try {
   window = GetWindow<LayoutCheck>();
   window.titleContent = new GUIContent("Petya layout verification");
   window.position = new Rect(100,100,400,560);
   /* IMPORT_CALLS */
   window.Show();
   deadline = EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup + 15;
   EditorApplication.update += Tick;
  } catch(Exception error) { Fail(error); }
 }
 static void Attach(string provider, string assetPath) {
  if(!importedPaths.Add(assetPath))throw new Exception("Import overwrote another layout");
  var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<VisualTreeAsset>(assetPath);
  if(asset == null) throw new Exception(provider + ": no imported VisualTreeAsset");
  var clone = asset.CloneTree();
  clone.style.height = 260;
  clones.Add(provider,clone);
  window.rootVisualElement.Add(clone);
 }
 static void Near(float actual,float expected,string message) {
  if(float.IsNaN(actual) || Math.Abs(actual-expected)>.1f) throw new Exception(message + ": " + actual + " != " + expected);
 }
 static void Tick() {
  try {
   window.Repaint();
   if(EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup < deadline) return;
   foreach(var pair in clones) {
    var root=pair.Value.Q<VisualElement>("layer-1");
    var panel=pair.Value.Q<VisualElement>("layer-2");
    var label=pair.Value.Q<Label>("layer-3");
    if(root==null||panel==null||label==null||label.text!="Hello Unity")throw new Exception(pair.Key+": wrong imported hierarchy/text");
    Near(root.resolvedStyle.width,320,pair.Key+" root width");Near(root.resolvedStyle.height,240,pair.Key+" root height");
    Near(panel.resolvedStyle.left,20,pair.Key+" panel x");Near(panel.resolvedStyle.top,30,pair.Key+" panel y");
    Near(label.resolvedStyle.left,16,pair.Key+" label x");Near(label.resolvedStyle.top,16,pair.Key+" label y");
    Near(label.resolvedStyle.width,220,pair.Key+" label width");Near(label.resolvedStyle.height,32,pair.Key+" label height");
    Near(label.resolvedStyle.fontSize,24,pair.Key+" font size");
    Near(label.resolvedStyle.color.r,1,pair.Key+" red");Near(label.resolvedStyle.color.g,0,pair.Key+" green");Near(label.resolvedStyle.color.b,0,pair.Key+" blue");
    Near(label.worldBound.x-root.worldBound.x,36,pair.Key+" world x");
    Near(label.worldBound.y-root.worldBound.y,46,pair.Key+" world y");
   }
   File.WriteAllText("verification.txt","PASS: Figma and Zeplin imported by production C#; actual UI Toolkit layout: 320x240 root, nested offsets 20,30 + 16,16, 220x32 text, 24px red font. Existing assets preserved by unique paths.");
   EditorApplication.update-=Tick;EditorApplication.Exit(0);
  } catch(Exception error) { Fail(error); }
 }
 static void Fail(Exception error) {
  File.WriteAllText("verification.txt",error.ToString());Debug.LogException(error);EditorApplication.Exit(1);
 }
}
